run_ZnCodec_benchmark: run a benchmark of ZnCodec find_nn nearest neighbor search on random integer codes
run_IndexPQ_benchmark: run a benchmark of FAISS IndexPQ search on random float32 vectors
create_ZnCodec_instance: create a ZnCodec instance with a given dimension and radius squared parameter
run_ZnCodec_find_nn: run the ZnCodec find_nn method to search nearest neighbors for query vectors
create_IndexPQ_instance: create a FAISS IndexPQ instance with specified dimension and subquantizer parameters
